senses.gloss: m. (לְקִי; transl. of λεπτόν) a very small copper coin. Y. Maas. Sh. IV, beg. 54ᵈ ובארבאל בתרין אלפין ול׳ (not ובאדבאל … יל׳) and in Arbela the Denar is worth two thousand P’rutahs and one Lakan.—
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 4:1:2">Y. B. Mets. IV, beg. 9ᶜ</cite> <he>ל׳ בל׳ אסיר</he> to lend money on Lakan against L. (counting Lakans in place of Denars) is forbidden.
